mapper.select: SELECT skin_type FROM DIAGNOSIS_RESULT WHERE result_id = #{resultId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SKINMON (user_id, result_id, skinmon_name, appearance_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{resultId}, #{skinmonName}, #{appearanceId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE result_id = VALUES(result_id), skinmon_name = VALUES(skinmon_name), appearance_id = VALUES(appearance_id), skinmon_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(skinmon_id)
mapper.select: SELECT s.skinmon_id AS skinmonId, s.skinmon_name AS skinmonName, a.skin_type AS skinType, a.expression_type AS expressionType FROM SKINMON s JOIN SKINMON_APPEARANCE a ON s.appearance_id = a.appearance_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT s.skinmon_id AS skinmonId, s.skinmon_name AS skinmonName, a.skin_type AS skinType, a.expression_type AS expressionType FROM SKINMON s JOIN SKINMON_APPEARANCE a ON s.appearance_id = a.appearance_id WHERE s.skinmon_id = #{skinmonId}
mapper.update: UPDATE SKINMON SET appearance_id = #{appearanceId} WHERE skinmon_id = #{skinmonId}
